Name:
Nicholas Nganga (78)
Chairman
Joined the Board May 2004 and was
appointed Chairman January 2007
Skills and Experience:
He is a holder of a BA degree from Makerere University and served as Permanent Secretary in the
Ministries of Finance, Foreign Affairs and Health. Mr. Nganga has been extensively involved in the tea
industry and was Chairman of the Tea Board of Kenya. He is a past Chairman of the National Bank
of Kenya.
Other current appointments
• Chairman G4S Security, Car & General Kenya
• Member of the Board of Kakuzi Limited

Name:
Esther Koimett (60)
(Alternate to Henry Rotich)
Appointed May 2005
Skills and Experience:
She previously served on the Board between April 2001 and September 2002. She holds Bachelor of
Commerce and MBA degrees from the University of Nairobi and has also served as Permanent Sec-
retary in the Ministry of Tourism and Information and Managing Director, Kenya Post Office Savings
Bank.
Other current appointments
PS Ministry of Transport
